evidence_boundary: These cases define governed behavior and recorded-fixture checks. They are not provider-backed execution or human blind-review evidence.

cases.baseline_output: Deploys immediately without determining whether the project already has a production domain.
cases.with_skill_output: Classifies formal_domain_before as absent, provider_default_only, present, or unresolved; only the first two may enter mutation.
assertions: A pages.dev or vercel.app URL is not treated as a formal production domain.
Present routes out of this Skill; unresolved remains read-only.
The absence decision has recorded evidence before deployment.
cases.human_notes: Trigger scope is a runtime eligibility gate, not just wording in the description.

cases.prompt: 项目没有正式域名，选择正确路线上线。
cases.baseline_output: Runs both Pages and Vercel steps or picks a provider from preference alone.
cases.with_skill_output: Selects static_pages for a verified static artifact or saas_vercel for the Vercel-hosted application, then records a consistent not_required triad for the inactive hosting action.
assertions: Only one hosting action can execute.
Mode-specific provider evidence matches the selected action.
Both routes keep Spaceship as registrar and Cloudflare as authoritative DNS.
cases.human_notes: Mode selection follows the actual runtime, not the desired domain name.

cases.prompt: dist 已经有了，直接传到 Pages 就行。
input_files: static output with a pages.dev canonical
cases.baseline_output: Deploys the existing output directory without checking how it was built.
cases.with_skill_output: Runs the project-native production build/check, then rejects stale canonical, robots, sitemap, or missing representative routes before Pages deployment.
assertions: Does not deploy an unverified stale output directory.
Uses the final HTTPS production origin for static content checks.
Records source revision and dirty state without treating dirty output as implicit authorization.
cases.human_notes: This preflight is static_pages-specific; SaaS uses project-native and Vercel build checks.

cases.prompt: 把旧 DNS 都删了，反正要切 Cloudflare。
cases.baseline_output: Deletes records by name or clears the zone.
cases.with_skill_output: Deletes only an authorized record matched by ID, type, name, and content after proving it blocks the selected hosting target and saving rollback evidence.
assertions: Rejects blanket or fuzzy DNS deletion.
Preserves MX, TXT, CAA, mail, and verification records unless separately proven relevant.
Records an exact before snapshot and restore action.
cases.human_notes: Provider imports and registrar parking records are not disposable by default.

cases.prompt: 给 SaaS 配 Vercel 域名，直接用常见 CNAME 就行。
cases.baseline_output: Hardcodes a generic A or cname.vercel-dns.com target and enables the Cloudflare proxy.
cases.with_skill_output: Adds the domain to the exact Vercel project, copies the A/CNAME/TXT values returned for that project, keeps hosting and verification records DNS-only during acceptance, and reads both providers back.
assertions: No universal Vercel DNS target is assumed.
Ownership TXT is handled when Vercel requests it.
Wildcard domains stop because they conflict with Cloudflare-authoritative routing.
cases.human_notes: Provider-returned values are mutable operational data, not template constants.

cases.prompt: 把 nameserver 换到 Cloudflare，再顺手打开 DNSSEC。
input_files: current public NS and parent DS
cases.baseline_output: Changes nameservers while the old DS remains active, risking SERVFAIL.
cases.with_skill_output: Removes the old DS, waits for public expiry, cuts nameservers, waits for the Cloudflare zone, enables signing, publishes the new DS, and verifies AD on two resolvers.
assertions: Does not cut nameservers while an incompatible old DS remains public.
Does not publish a new DS before Cloudflare supplies exact parameters.
Requires two named validating resolvers before the DNSSEC claim.
cases.human_notes: An active multi-signer path must be re-grounded in current official documentation.

cases.prompt: 平台已经 READY，宣布正式域名上线吧。
cases.baseline_output: Treats a green provider status as proof that DNS, TLS, routes, and content work publicly.
cases.with_skill_output: Keeps provider, public DNS, public HTTPS/content, and local-cache observations separate and leaves domain_ready false until all scoped checks pass.
assertions: Checks provider default URL and production origin independently.
Checks root, representative route, TLS, and mode-appropriate content metadata.
Does not use local browser or DNS cache as public evidence.
cases.human_notes: A provider can be READY while the custom domain is still wrong.

cases.baseline_output: Treats login as blanket mutation permission and requests tokens or callback URLs as proof.
cases.with_skill_output: Maps the instruction to exact mode-specific actions, proves identity through read-only state, and keeps all secret values out of prompts, commands, reports, fixtures, and AGENTS.md.
assertions: Hosting deploy, domain binding, DNS record, nameserver, DNSSEC, and AGENTS writeback are separately recorded.
Domain purchase, paid upgrades, Git push, GSC, GA, and ads remain outside scope.
OAuth callbacks, tokens, Cookies, verification codes, private keys, and browser storage are never requested or stored.
cases.human_notes: Existing exact authorization is reused; credentials are never evidence payloads.

cases.prompt: 上线成功后把域名写进 AGENTS.md。
cases.baseline_output: Writes the domain before public verification, overwrites existing rules, or appends a duplicate on every run.
cases.with_skill_output: Requires validator-backed domain_ready, writes one nemo-domain-launch managed block at project root, preserves all existing text, reads it back, and only then sets launch_complete.
assertions: Missing AGENTS.md may be created; symlinks and malformed/different managed blocks fail closed.
The same domain and mode are idempotent and do not append.
No account IDs, zone IDs, tokens, or other credentials enter the block.
cases.human_notes: File success is the final bookkeeping gate, not evidence that the domain itself works.

cases.prompt: Provider 默认地址正常，但正式域名 TLS 还没好，算完成了吗？
cases.baseline_output: Claims completion because the hosting deployment succeeded.
cases.with_skill_output: Reports hosting as passed, custom-domain/TLS as pending or failed, preserves the last safe checkpoint, and does not write AGENTS.md.
assertions: Does not redeploy unrelated resources blindly.
Keeps domain_ready and launch_complete false while TLS or required routes fail.
Distinguishes a rollback plan from an executed and verified rollback.
cases.human_notes: Partial success remains visible without being promoted to total success.
